items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I jotted down a few — I think it’s really fascinating that you played on “Escalator Over the Hill,” and then you played with John Lennon. Is that true? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Howard Johnson is a virtuoso on the tuba, baritone saxophone, and pennywhistle, and has collaborated with Gil Evans, the “Saturday Night Live”
band, and John Lennon, among many others. Howard directed and recorded with Gravity, his own innovative ensemble that included four tubas.
Howard was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
